layers.basis: Estimate: a single-MCU logic board, both sides populated, many vias; not visible in a photo

burden.basis: EMS material burden at 100k+ boards (cost-plus EMS practice: 10 % at 1k, 7 % at 10k, 5 % at 100k+), the tool's stated rate

usd.basis: FX used for US$ list prices

aspCny.basis: Chaoying (超颖) 4–6-layer board ASP 2024, prospectus p.1-1-229 (automotive is its main use) — https://pdf.dfcfw.com/pdf/H2_AN202503311649612309_1.pdf

aspRise.basis: Mid of the +12–17 % automotive PCB price rise to Q1 2026 (Sina, 17 Sep 2026)

base2L.basis: CostVision PCB country table, China: 2-layer base (used only for the layer shape)

layerAdd.basis: CostVision PCB country table, China: per layer above 2 (layer shape)

aspAnchor.basis: The 4–6-layer ASP is a 4 / 6 mix: anchored at 5 layers

class3Cny.basis: PCBasic: 25 µm hole copper +¥25/m², 4-wire test +¥80/m² — https://www.pcbasic.com/standard_pcb.html

joints.basis: Reading: every SMD pad (2 a two-terminal part, IC pins) — the unit the Chinese price lists use

smtUsdJ.basis: JLCPCB Standard PCBA, > 100,000 joints an order: $0.0012 per SMT joint, paste and AOI inside (page 22 Oct 2026) — https://jlcpcb.com/help/article/pcb-assembly-price

changeH.basis: Estimate: line changeover per side per lot (feeder kit pre-set off line)

smtHS.basis: CostVision rate book, China: high-speed SMT line

opRate.basis: CostVision rate book, China: electronics assembly operator, fully loaded

techRate.basis: CostVision rate book, China: technician, fully loaded

ict.basis: CostVision rate book, China: ICT bed-of-nails test system (also the functional-tester proxy)

coatRate.basis: CostVision PCB country table, China: conformal coating (material + machine)

coatCm2.basis: Reading: board net of the shaft opening and window ≈ 90 cm²; the component areas ≈ 70 % of it (given: coating on the component areas)

coatSides.basis: Reading: coating visible on the component areas of both sides

uvSec.basis: Estimate: UV inspection of the coating (selective robot coating — no masking; the program skips pads and pin holes)

ictSec.basis: Estimate: bed-of-nails ICT on the bottom test pads (322 parts)

fctSec.basis: Estimate: board functional test (supplies, CAN, sense channels, gate-drive supply)

finalSec.basis: Estimate: final visual inspection and 2D-code read

unquotedOH.basis: Overhead on the rate-book operations (list prices carry the seller's margin; none is added on them)

reworkMin.basis: Rework per failed board (technician) + a re-test

nre.basis: Stencils 2 × £150, ICT fixture £5,000, FCT fixture £8,000, coating program £800, programming set-up £500, bare-board E-test / route tooling £800

boardKg.basis: Given in the form: 40 g populated (estimate — board 1.6 mm FR-4 net of the cut-outs ≈ 28 g + parts)

packKg.basis: Share of ESD bag + divider + carton

seaKg.basis: CostVision PCB country table, China: sea freight

duty.basis: CostVision PCB country table, China → UK: import duty (assumption, HS line not confirmed)
